execution.raw_artifact_policy: Prompts, responses, JSONL, grader output, and temporary Skill directories remained under /tmp and are not retained in the repository.
execution.verdict_policy: Grade only assertions assigned to each condition. A failed critical assertion fails the condition; a partial result without a critical failure is partial. Material value is graded separately with anonymous response labels.

matrix_format.evidence: evidence reference shared by the condition; material-value evidence is recorded separately

iterations.result: The candidate exposed missing owner retention for duplicate candidates, unsupported completion-detail expansion, inferred expected behavior, missing data-handling and filing-next-actor notes, and a continuation routing collision.
Affected behavior cases were rerun after each relevant body correction. The full routing suite was rerun after the description change; later body-only corrections reused that routing evidence.

The first grader schema allowed an additional_requirement pseudo-assertion. Stored responses were regraded with exact assertion IDs, and the duplicate case was rerun after the corrected grader exposed optional-placeholder and owner-handoff gaps.

Unchanged candidate responses were reused only where later localized instructions did not apply to the case. Current, no-Skill, and anonymous material-value evidence was retained for the four unaffected comparison cases.

unverified: Claude and other clients were not executed.
Actual GitHub, Jira, Redmine, Backlog, or other tracker connectors and permission systems were not used.
No live network, template retrieval, duplicate search, Issue creation, label mutation, or assignment was performed.
Repeated-run stability and model variation were not evaluated because the corrected matched runs were decision-consistent.
Current-baseline routing and no-Skill routing were not executed; routing evaluation targeted the changed candidate description and coexistence boundary.
